items.title: PraisonAI Editor
items.description: Word-level timestamps in SRT, TXT, or JSON. OpenAI Whisper + local faster-whisper.

items.title: Quick Start
items.description: Get from zero to an edited file in under 2 minutes.

children.title: AI Agent Prompt-Based Editing
children.description: Edit media using plain English instructions. An AI agent interprets your prompt and creates a precise edit plan.

children.title: Agent Tools
children.description: Three built-in tools for use with PraisonAI agents. They auto-register via the praisonaiagents.tools entry-point.

items.title: Python API Overview
items.description: Use praisonai-editor directly from Python — no CLI needed.

children.title: `edit_media()` — Main API
children.description: === "Music extraction"

children.title: Data Models
children.description: All models live in praisonai_editor.models and are plain Python dataclasses.

children.title: Edit Plans API
children.description: An EditPlan is a list of segments with keep or remove actions.

children.title: Transcription API

items.title: Artifacts & Caching
items.description: Every edit or transcribe run saves artifacts to ~/.praisonai/editor/{filename}/.

children.title: `convert` — Convert between formats
children.description: Convert between audio and video formats using FFmpeg.

children.title: `edit` — Full editing pipeline
children.description: The main command. Runs transcription → content detection → plan → render in one shot.

children.title: `plan` — Preview the edit plan
children.description: See what would be removed before actually editing the file.

children.title: `probe` — Inspect media metadata
children.description: Use probe to quickly check the metadata of any audio or video file.

children.title: `transcribe` — Audio/video to text
children.description: Transcribe any audio or video file with word-level timestamps.

items.title: 🎵 Stem Separation (Demix)
items.description: Powered by Demucs — an AI model that separates audio into vocal and instrument tracks.

children.title: Stem Cache
children.description: Demucs stem separation is slow on CPU (5–15 min for a 40-min file). The stem cache ensures it only runs once per file.

children.title: Primary Zone Detection (`--primary-zone`)
children.description: Automatically finds and extracts the main singing section from a long recording.

items.title: Content Detection Overview
items.description: Content detection classifies each second of your media into types like speech, music, singing, silence — enabling smart content-based editing.

children.title: Ensemble detector (`--detector ensemble`)
children.description: The recommended detector. Combines multiple detectors and uses a voting algorithm to pick the most confident classification for each segment.

children.title: FFmpeg heuristic detector (`--detector ffmpeg`)
children.description: Fastest detector. Uses FFmpeg's astats filter to get RMS/peak energy statistics per segment.

children.title: INA Speech Segmenter (`--detector ina`)
children.description: Uses a CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) trained on broadcast media to detect speech vs music vs noise vs silence.

children.title: Librosa spectral detector (`--detector librosa`)
children.description: Uses spectral features (RMS energy, spectral centroid, zero-crossing rate) from librosa to classify segments.

items.title: Presets Overview
items.description: Presets are named editing profiles. Pick the one closest to your use case.

children.title: `clean` preset
children.description: Maximum cleanup. Tightest silence removal.

children.title: `course` preset
children.description: Best for: online courses, lectures, tutorials, screencasts.

children.title: `meeting` preset
children.description: Best for: team meetings, standups, recorded calls.

children.title: `no_silence` preset
children.description: Keep everything — just remove silent gaps between segments.

children.title: `podcast` preset
children.description: Best for: podcast recordings, interviews, solo recordings.

children.title: `songs_only` preset
children.description: Extract only the singing/music portions from a recording. Removes speech, talking, and silence.

children.title: `speech_only` preset
children.description: Extract only speech portions — removes music, singing, and silence.

items.title: Extending with Protocols
items.description: Every stage of the pipeline is defined as a Python Protocol — swap in your own implementation without touching core code.

children.title: Custom Editor
children.description: Write your own logic for creating edit plans (what to keep and remove).

children.title: Custom Renderer
children.description: Replace FFmpeg rendering with your own engine (e.g., moviepy, pydub).

children.title: Custom Transcriber
children.description: Replace OpenAI Whisper with any speech-to-text engine.
